runtime_status: Only pre-selection Grid implementation existed at first read. This record approves no new selection source bytes.
assessment: Single immutable indexed range plus finitely bounded stable-key exceptions is suitable for opt-in portable selection without hidden owner scans, provided set membership/count/iteration and selection/cursor transitions share atomic admission.
required_contracts: Current-view selected range captures an immutable concurrency-readable indexed revision; filtering/sorting preserves captured membership and does not imply domain deletion.

Toggling a newly added current key absent from the captured index needs an explicit bounded additive-key representation or an explicitly documented recapture policy. Count arithmetic must handle retained old keys plus new additions without overflow.
Shift anchor absent from current filtered view requires deterministic documented fallback.

Sparse key retention is capped by count and per-key bytes; retained stamp/anchor/override strings are detached. Captured source-index memory is borrowed and separately scoped, not claimed bounded by Grid viewport payload.
Detached Selection values retain immutable state/index without a Grid/application backpointer. Default legacy mode never requests SelectionSnapshot.
Contains validates accessed row/index/stamp before and after bounded reads; errors cannot mutate selection. Clear/new-incarnation reset do not read a broken old capture.

Visit runs only explicitly on caller workers, is cancellable before/among reads, allocates no whole selection list, visits each key once in deterministic order and documents partial callback delivery on cancellation/error.
Row-selected is computed once per materialized row. Selection-only and combined cursor-selection admission refuse atomically on source/capacity/revision/generation failure, preserving gesture refs.
recommended_adversarial_tests: Capture All over a million-row procedural index and assert bounded owner callbacks and zero row enumeration.
Toggle new keys after same-incarnation membership changes, then verify Contains/Count/Visit exact set and detached old selection.
Shift with removed anchor; same-incarnation reverse/filter/height changes; new incarnation reset.
Failure during selection capture, current/captured index lookup and final revision checks preserves cursor, viewport, selection, generation and refs.
Corrupted captured index causes Contains/Visit refusal but Clear succeeds without querying it.
MaxSelectionKeys/counted-byte refusal, MaxInt selected-count overflow, sparse override cancellation and generation exhaustion.
Concurrent Contains/Visit on detached old snapshot while owner replaces/clears/extends selection; copy identity and retention type graph tests.
Default Grid tests/counters, variable-height Page and opaque stale press identity remain unchanged.
limits: No candidate writes, canonical writes, Git, GUI, Prism or tests. Exact selection implementation needs a later source-bound review.
